about.title: About the app
about.intro: “Kje so igrala?” is a community app that helps parents across Slovenia find the perfect playground.
about.what: Browse playgrounds on the map, filter by shade, fences and drinking water, and read other parents' reviews. Anyone can add a new playground and help the community grow.
about.authorBody: I'm Nejc Bevk, and I build this app in my spare time. It's a personal project, born from wanting a better overview of playgrounds for our little ones.
about.supportBody: The app is free and ad-free. If you like it, you can buy me a coffee. Thank you! ☕
about.supportCta: Buy me a coffee on Ko-fi

import.title: Import from CSV
import.intro: Paste or upload a CSV. Rows with an address get geocoded; rows with lat/lng are used directly.
import.formatHelp: Columns: name, address (or lat + lng), description, surface, fenced, shade, water, toilets, parking.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes how we collect and use your data, in line with GDPR and Slovenia's ZVOP-2.

processors.title: Data processors
processors.vercelAnalytics: Vercel Analytics: anonymous, cookieless page-view statistics

location.title: Your location
location.body: If you use the "Locate me" feature, your position is processed only in your browser to move the map. It is never sent to our servers or stored.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.body: Your data is kept as long as your account exists. When you delete your account, your profile, reviews, photos, favorites and reports are permanently removed; playgrounds you submitted remain without your authorship. Technical server logs are kept by our hosting providers for a short period (up to 30 days).

rights.title: Your rights
items: Right of access: you can export your data from your profile.
Right to erasure: you can delete your account from your profile.

photos.title: Photos of children
photos.body: Identifiable faces of children are not allowed. You can flag inappropriate content with the Report button.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using this app you agree to these terms. The app is a free, community-driven directory of playgrounds in Slovenia, provided as-is by an individual maintainer.

content.title: Your content
content.body: You are responsible for the content you submit (playgrounds, reviews, photos). Only upload photos you took yourself, and never photos with identifiable faces of children. By submitting content you grant us a non-exclusive right to display it in the app.

conduct.title: Acceptable use
conduct.body: Don't post spam, misleading information, or content that violates anyone's privacy or rights. Content can be reported by other users; content with multiple reports is reviewed and may be removed.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.body: We may edit, flag, or remove any content and suspend accounts that repeatedly break these rules.

liability.title: No warranty
liability.body: Playground information is community-contributed and may be inaccurate or outdated. Always assess the safety of a playground yourself. We accept no liability for damages arising from use of the app.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms; significant changes will be announced in the app. Continued use after a change means you accept the updated terms.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about these terms? Contact us at {email}.
